Society members are stopped from playing Garba in their own compound by bouncers and Vishwasur, who claims the main area is reserved only for high-paying VIP pass holders, forcing the residents to dance in the garden area instead.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
